definition: אֶ֫רֶג noun [masculine] loom (see GFM POS Oct.1889 ) — אֶרֶג Judg 16:4 hand-loom to which Samson's hair was fastened, plucked up by him ( ׳ א object of וַיִּסַּע ; strike out הַיְתַד as gloss, compare GFM above); Job 7:6 יָמַי קַלּוּ מִנִּי אָ֑רֶג my days are swifter than a loom. אַרְגֹּב see רגב . אַרְגָּז see רגז .
